records.title: Mamba or RWKV: Exploring High-Quality and High-Efficiency Segment Anything Model
records.reason: The work optimizes image segmentation on high-resolution vision inputs using Mamba/RWKV; it is not LLM inference or language-model serving.

records.title: Baichuan2-Sum: Instruction Finetune Baichuan2-7B Model for Dialogue Summarization
records.reason: This is dialogue summarization instruction fine-tuning and task-quality evaluation; the efficiency discussion is about training technique, not LLM inference/serving.

records.title: A Hybrid Framework of Transformer Encoder and Residential Conventional for Cardiovascular Disease Recognition Using Heart Sounds
records.reason: The paper classifies heart-sound recordings for cardiovascular diagnosis with conventional/transformer classifiers; it does not concern language-model inference.

records.title: Point Cloud Generation using Transformer Encoders and Normalising Flows
records.reason: The work generates particle-physics point clouds using normalizing flows and transformer encoders; it is unrelated to LLM serving efficiency.

records.title: Proteus: Achieving High-Performance Processing-Using-DRAM with Dynamic Bit-Precision, Adaptive Data Representation, and Flexible Arithmetic
records.reason: Proteus optimizes processing-in-DRAM hardware primitives across general applications; the abstract does not present an LLM inference or serving contribution.
